name: selector.note_on_adapter
meaning: normalize Note On trigger note; velocity saved

name: selector.default_note
meaning: fallback metadata note is unchanged Trigger Note

name: selector.slot_index
meaning: r3 = trigger slot index; preserved until Playback Note map read

name: selector.state_load
meaning: load ARMED state before any Playback Note read

name: selector.gate_state
meaning: not ARMED fallback keeps r5 = Trigger Note

name: selector.slot_offset
meaning: r6 = source offset from trigger slot; r3 remains slot index

name: selector.slot_base_add
meaning: source slot selected solely by trigger slot

name: selector.valid_load
meaning: selected slot valid before Playback Note read

name: selector.gate_valid
meaning: invalid source fallback keeps r5 = Trigger Note

name: selector.map_base
meaning: Playback Note map base after ARMED+valid gates

name: selector.load_playback_note
meaning: r5 = Playback Note metadata byte only after fail-closed gates

name: selector.select_source_seed
meaning: source base seed after metadata read

name: selector.select_source
meaning: source = trigger-selected resident slot; no playback-note-to-source mapping

name: selector.pop_return
meaning: restore trigger registers and Note On velocity

name: producer.lock_pointer
meaning: lock pointer; redundant r9 length gate removed

name: producer.reset_state_store
meaning: state EMPTY hides stale map until ARMED
